string.name: EntryAbility_desc
string.value: Connect to OpenBitFun desktop and control remote sessions

string.name: permission_camera_reason
string.value: Used to scan the OpenBitFun desktop remote connection QR code.

string.name: permission_read_pasteboard_reason
string.value: Used to paste the OpenBitFun desktop remote connection link.

string.name: permission_microphone_reason
string.value: Used to turn speech into text to send in a conversation.

string.name: permission_distributed_datasync_reason
string.value: Used to authorize a watch on the same OpenBitFun account so you do not have to type the password on the watch.
